def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format a Unix timestamp in seconds as HH:MM:SS in UTC."""
    pre ts >= 0
    post out.char_count() == 8
    ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
    ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
    ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
    secs = ts % 86400
    h = secs // 3600
    m = (secs % 3600) // 60
    s = secs % 60
    h_str = f"{h}" if h >= 10 else f"0{h}"
    m_str = f"{m}" if m >= 10 else f"0{m}"
    s_str = f"{s}" if s >= 10 else f"0{s}"
    return f"{h_str}:{m_str}:{s_str}"
